# Week 3 Start/Sit Briefing — Wednesday, 2026-09-23

## Source and freshness

**Live** — `nflreadpy` (schedules, rosters, player stats, depth charts, injuries) + the repo's fitted `AvailabilityModel`, run end-to-end via `generate_report.py` at 2026-09-23T20:14:39Z. `season_week.load_current_week_nflreadpy` returns Week 3, consistent with the Week 3 slate (Thu 9/24 – Mon 9/28) not yet having kicked off.

`nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` returned 22 rows for Week 3 — but **every single one belongs to Atlanta or Green Bay**, the two teams playing Thursday night. No other team, including six of our roster's teams playing Sunday/Monday, has posted a Week 3 report yet in this data pull. That's expected timing (most clubs file Wednesday evening, this run is early afternoon US time) — not a source failure — but it means today's practice-report picture is genuinely partial. Re-check Saturday for the fuller Friday-designation picture.

ESPN and Rotowire are proxy-blocked in this sandbox (expected); Sleeper was not queried since the nflreadpy report was non-empty. No FantasyPros key is configured, so all four positions run on the in-house model rather than vendor consensus — doesn't change this week's headline finding.

## Practice report

**None of our 15 rostered players (10 starters + 5 bench) carry any injury or practice designation yet.** Checked by GSIS id against all 22 reported rows. Matthew Golden (GB) and Drake London (ATL) — the two rostered players in Thursday's game, the only game with a report out yet — are both **absent from the list entirely**, which under nflreadpy's convention means no reported concern, not an unresolved status. There is nothing to bucket by DNP/Limited/Full this week: no rostered player is on any team's report.

**That is not this week's real story.** Two things outside the injury feed matter more:

1. **Jaxson Dart (QB, our starter) was demoted to backup on NYG's own depth chart this morning (2026-09-23).** He was Rank 1 continuously through Tuesday; as of the 06:02 UTC and 12:43 UTC snapshots today, Jameis Winston is listed QB1 and Dart QB2. This lines up with the box score: Dart played 69 of 69 snaps (100%) in Week 1, then just 7 of 58 (12%) in Week 2 while Winston played the other 51. No injury designation has been filed for Dart in any week this season — this reads as a performance benching, not (confirmed) an injury, but the absence of any explanation is itself worth watching.
2. **Brock Bowers (TE, bench) has played zero snaps in 2026** — Out/knee Week 1, Doubtful/knee Week 2 — and no Week 3 designation exists yet anywhere. His projection below is driven mostly by 2025 history via the model's shrinkage, not by any signal that his knee has actually cleared. Treat his number as provisional until a real Week 3 report appears.

## Start these ten

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected pts | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| RB | Jonathan Taylor | vs HOU | **10.15** | 93.2% | 10.88 |
| RB | Bucky Irving | vs MIN | **7.30** | 93.2% | 7.83 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | @WAS | **5.79** | 95.5% | 6.06 |
| WR | Drake London | @GB (Thu 8:15pm) | **4.27** | 95.5% | 4.47 |
| TE | Brock Bowers | @NO (Sun 4:25pm) | **4.37** | 73.8% | 5.92 |
| FLEX | Cam Skattebo | vs TEN | **6.56** | 93.2% | 7.03 |
| FLEX | Jameson Williams | vs NYJ | **4.04** | 84.2% | 4.80 |
| K | Cameron Dicker | @BUF | **4.16** | 97.9% | 4.25 |
| DEF | Eagles D/ST | @CHI (Mon 8:15pm) | **4.73** | 100% | 4.73 |

**Lineup total (expected): 62.60** (Monday's briefing had 59.49 — the gain is almost entirely the QB swap below, not new information about the rest of the roster.)

**Sit:** Jaxson Dart (7.38 exp — see above), Matthew Golden (2.84), Isaiah Likely (3.37, provisional — see caveats), Tee Higgins (3.83), Josh Downs (3.43).

## Changes since Monday

**Start Stafford over Dart.** This is the one change with a real, current-events reason behind it: NYG benched Dart mid-Week-2 (12% snap share) and made it official on the depth chart this morning, with no fantasy-relevant explanation on record yet. Stafford was already the stronger expected-points play among the two (11.23 vs 7.38) even before accounting for the demotion risk — his conditional number is also higher (11.73 vs 10.61). This is not a thin-margin call.

**Start Bowers over Likely at TE — flag this one as low-confidence.** Bowers now projects 4.37 to Likely's 3.37, but Bowers has not played a single snap in 2026 and carries no Week 3 report yet, so that number leans heavily on prior-season shrinkage rather than anything current. Likely has actually played both weeks (19.8, then 3.3 points). If you want the safer hold, Likely-over-Bowers is defensible; re-run Wednesday's numbers again Saturday once a real Bowers designation exists.

**WR/FLEX rotation shuffles again, thin margins, no new signal.** Monday's lineup started Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Jameson Williams at WR with Cam Skattebo and Matthew Golden at FLEX (Drake London benched). Today's optimal instead starts Smith-Njigba and London at WR, with Skattebo and Williams at FLEX, dropping Golden to the bench. The same four skill players (JSN, London, Williams, Golden) are separated by about 3 points total and have been reordering week to week on 2-3 games of data with no fresh injury signal — treat this as noise around a roughly even tier, not a real recommendation to chase.

## Still uncertain

- **Jaxson Dart** — is this an injury being withheld pending the official report, or a clean benching? Nothing here resolves it. If NYG issues an actual injury designation for him before Friday, revisit; if not, this looks like a genuine QB change and Stafford should stay the start going forward, not just this week.
- **Brock Bowers** — zero games played in 2026, last known state Doubtful/knee (Week 2), no Week 3 word yet. The single biggest swing risk in this lineup. Friday's designation is decisive.
- **All Sunday/Monday-slate rostered players** (13 of 15) — no Week 3 practice report has posted for any of their teams yet (NYG, IND, TB, SEA, CIN, DET, LAC, PHI, LAR, LV). Re-run captures the real picture once those land, likely Wednesday evening or Thursday US time.

## Opponent notes

- **Three rostered Giants — Dart, Skattebo, Likely — all play TEN this week**, same as Monday's note; correlated risk unchanged. Dart's demotion doesn't reduce that exposure since Skattebo and Likely still start.
- **Golden (GB) and London (ATL) face each other Thursday night** — same game as Monday's note. Neither shows an injury concern, so this is purely a game-script question now.
- **Taylor and Downs share an opponent** (both IND vs HOU) — no lineup implication.

## Byes ahead

**None in the next two weeks (Weeks 3–4).** The nearest bye on this roster is **Cameron Dicker (K, LAC), Week 7** — four weeks out, not yet a planning concern.

## Caveats

- Only Atlanta and Green Bay have posted any Week 3 injury/practice report as of this run (2026-09-23T20:14:39Z) — the other ten teams on this roster have not filed yet. Every "no designation" above means "nothing reported," not "cleared."
- Jaxson Dart's demotion is read from NYG's public depth chart and Week 2 snap counts, not from an injury report — no official reason has been given anywhere in the data this run can see.
- Brock Bowers' 4.37 expected points rests mainly on 2025 performance via the model's shrinkage; he has played zero 2026 snaps and his current health is unconfirmed. Treat the Bowers-over-Likely call as provisional.
- FantasyPros consensus tier unavailable in this sandbox (no API key); Taylor/Irving/JSN/Likely/Bowers/Golden/London/Williams/Downs/Higgins/Stafford/Dart all run on the in-house model rather than vendor consensus. Doesn't change the QB call, which is driven by the depth-chart fact pattern rather than the projection itself.
- ESPN's and Rotowire's endpoints are proxy-blocked in this sandbox (expected); Sleeper was not separately queried since nflreadpy's report was non-empty for the week.
- The WR/FLEX shuffle (JSN/London/Williams/Golden) remains a thin-margin, low-confidence call on 2-3 games of data — don't read it as a strong signal.
